purpose: Define finite code/enumeration sets as explicit identities with stable code values, labels and additive/breaking evolution rules.

topics.name: Code Set and Enumeration
topics.purpose: Define finite code/enumeration sets as explicit identities with stable code values, labels and additive/breaking evolution rules.

semantics.identity_rule: Each code set and machine-significant member has explicit identity/code.
semantics.code_rule: Machine code is distinct from localized display label.
semantics.additive_rule: New optional codes may be additive only when consumers support unknown-code semantics.
semantics.breaking_rule: Changing meaning of an existing code is breaking.
semantics.authority_rule: Enumeration value never grants AccessCore rights merely by name.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: unknown code mapped to nearest label
